name: moddeck
description: A side bar listing every mod and skill, one boxed row each: the suggest switch is green or red, a skin dropdown, and every other row runs its /command (or puts it in the prompt box when it needs your text).

autoOpen.title: Open automatically
autoOpen.description: Open the side bar at session start where the screen can dock it beside the chat (fullscreen terminal, desktop app). Never reopens it after you close it; /moddeck toggles it.

skillRows.title: Skills shown at once
skillRows.description: How many skills the side bar shows before the list scrolls (▲ up / ▼ down).
